stories.title: Police officer killed in backpack blast in northern Spain
stories.summary: A backpack exploded in the city of Oviedo in northern Spain, killing one police officer and injuring a second, local authorities said. Police have not publicly described a motive and an investigation is under way.

stories.title: Malaysian court clears Najib for transfer to house arrest
stories.summary: A Malaysian court cleared former prime minister Najib Razak to be moved from prison to house arrest, a decision that has reignited a constitutional fight over the role of the attorney general and objections from the monarchy.

stories.title: Trump says Iran war is effectively over as strikes look unlikely
stories.summary: President Donald Trump said further US military strikes on Iran are highly unlikely, describing the war as effectively over militarily after talks with the Qatari prime minister at the White House. Regional mediators are still pushing negotiations to formally end the conflict.

stories.title: Ukraine peace talks resume in Abu Dhabi after months-long pause
stories.summary: US-brokered trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and American negotiators opened in Abu Dhabi, the first such session since February. US officials said both warring sides have shown some flexibility on the future of the Donetsk region.

stories.title: Seagate FireCuda Forge shuffles data between hard drive and SSD
stories.summary: Seagate unveiled the FireCuda Forge, a hybrid storage drive that automatically moves data between a spinning hard disk and solid-state storage to keep performance up without giving up capacity. It targets gamers and creators who want cheap bulk space plus fast load times.

stories.title: Trump says FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO ties to alleged Chinese spy
stories.summary: President Trump confirmed the FBI is examining Nvidia chief executive the relationship between Jensen Huang and a woman suspected of being a Chinese intelligence operative, while calling Huang a fine person. Nvidia shares fell sharply and the case has fuelled a Washington fight over chip exports to China.

stories.title: Australia weighs criminal penalties for rogue AI after OpenAI hack
stories.summary: Australia released 18 recommendations from a rapid review of recent AI-related breaches, including possible criminal penalties for rogue AI systems and mandatory, time-bound reporting of hacks by AI companies. The review followed a series of breaches disclosed by OpenAI.

stories.title: Anthropic reportedly moving ahead with IPO plans
stories.summary: Anthropic is reportedly pressing forward with an initial public offering, days after launching its new Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models. A listing would be a landmark test of public-market appetite for a pure-play AI lab.

stories.title: Browns have nothing brewing on eve of NFL trade deadline
stories.summary: Cleveland heads into the Tuesday trade deadline with no deals imminent, and defensive tackle Maliek Collins missed the Saints game with an illness. Cleveland sits at 5-4 with its offense still unsettled at quarterback.

stories.title: Browns enter quarterback controversy week before facing Texans
stories.summary: Todd Monken faces a quarterback decision for Sunday against Houston after Shedeur Sanders rallied Cleveland late in a 23-22 overtime loss to New Orleans. The defense has given up 501 rushing yards over the past three games, adding to the pressure on the offense.

stories.title: Browns defense leans on Schwesinger but folds late in overtime loss
stories.summary: Cleveland kept New Orleans out of the end zone for most of Sunday and got a strong outing from Carson Schwesinger, but gave up back-to-back touchdowns in the final minute and again in overtime. The 23-22 loss dropped the Browns to 5-4.

stories.title: Big-play potential returns to Browns offense with Sanders at QB
stories.summary: Shedeur Sanders gave Cleveland the explosive element its offense had been missing, creating chunk plays against the Saints in his fill-in start. The outing intensified debate over whether he should keep the job once Deshaun Watson is available.

stories.title: Ohio State makes the cut for 2028 five-star offensive tackle
stories.summary: Ohio State advanced in the recruitment of a five-star offensive tackle in the 2028 class, keeping the Buckeyes in a race that could shape the future of their offensive line. Recruiting has been one bright spot during a spiraling 2026 football season.

stories.title: Ohio State holds off Marshall 84-74 behind Mobley 19 points
stories.summary: Ohio State beat Marshall 84-74 on Monday night as John Mobley Jr. scored 19 points and the Buckeyes survived a late Herd rally. Freshmen Jimmie Williams and Anthony Thompson gave the rotation a lift in the nonconference win.

stories.title: Williams and Thompson shine as Buckeyes beat Marshall
stories.summary: On3 takeaways from the Ohio State win over Marshall centered on freshman guards Jimmie Williams and Anthony Thompson, who supplied the production the rotation needed. The two are emerging as rotation fixtures early in the season.

stories.title: FIA grants no extra engine upgrades in final 2026 ADUO review
stories.summary: The FIA said its third and final ADUO review of the season produced no new allowances even though the gaps between power units shifted. Red Bull Ford remains the benchmark, while Ferrari, Audi and Honda stay on the maximum upgrade allocation after finishing more than 4 percent down on combustion power.

stories.title: Honda still hunting root cause of Stroll's 13th retirement
stories.summary: Honda said it has not identified why Lance Stroll suffered another battery-related failure at the Brazilian Grand Prix, his 13th non-finish of the season. The reliability record has become a central problem for Aston Martin.

stories.title: Norris wet-weather masterclass silences the doubters again
stories.summary: Lando Norris won a wet-dry-wet Brazilian Grand Prix from pole, and The Race argues the drive confirms the McLaren driver belongs among the best in changeable conditions. Norris now has a world title and 14 wins to his name.

stories.title: How good is Hamilton and how long can he stay in F1?
stories.summary: BBC Sport weighs Lewis Hamilton's pace at Ferrari against his age and contract situation, asking how many more seasons at the front he realistically has. Hamilton endured another bruising weekend in Brazil, starting from the back of the grid.

stories.title: Battlestate reveals Escape from Tarkov Season 2 modifiers
stories.summary: Nikita Buyanov posted the full slate of personal modifiers coming with Tarkov's second season in December, including Advanced Hideout and Enhanced Secure Container on the positive side and Loose Tongue, Schizo and No Scav Runs as penalties. The season theme reveal is still to come, with the current Kord Breach season ending in early December.

stories.title: ODOT studies new interchange near Hocking Hills
stories.summary: ODOT is considering a new interchange near Hocking Hills as traffic and crashes rise on routes into the state park area outside Logan. The review comes as visitation to the region keeps climbing.

stories.title: Acton seeks more oversight of Ohio school vouchers
stories.summary: Ohio governor-elect Amy Acton wants tighter oversight of the state school voucher program, potentially changing how private-school scholarships are funded and audited. The proposal would be one of her first education moves before taking office.

stories.title: Pickerington schools hear hours of comment after levy fails
stories.summary: Pickerington Schools took two and a half hours of public comment at its first board meeting since voters rejected a levy, with parents and staff pressing members on what gets cut next. The district is now weighing reductions for the rest of the school year.

stories.title: Ohio State fraternity suspended after men set on fire in video
stories.summary: Ohio State placed a fraternity on interim suspension after video circulated showing two men engulfed in flames at a chapter gathering, an incident the university called extremely concerning. Students said they want more detail about what happened and what comes next.
